title: Quasi-coherent cohomology vanishes above the dimension of a Noetherian scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (a quasi-compact, locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth]), let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and let $q\geq0$ be strictly larger than the topological Krull dimension of $X$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Then the Zariski sheaf cohomology group $H^q(X,\mathcal F)$ [pqf-def-cohomology] is zero. The assertion also includes $X=\varnothing$, whose topological dimension is $-\infty$.
